tools.name: get_spec
tools.description: What it does: returns the full strategy grammar (every node type with its fields), the execution rules (signals at bar close, entry at the next bar's open, slippage against you, stop checked before target inside a bar, intraday only), the instruments (NQ, ES, GC) with tick size, point value and hour

tools.name: run_backtest
tools.description: What it does: runs one strategy spec against 15+ years of real 1-minute futures history (NQ by default; set spec.instrument to ES or GC) with realistic fills, slippage and commission, and saves the run to the user's private vault. Returns: run_id, metrics (trades, win rate, profit factor, net P&L in

tools.name: list_runs
tools.description: What it does: lists the user's saved backtests, newest first, optionally filtered by tag. Returns: runs[] with id, name, tags, instrument, timeframe, date range, created_at and the headline metrics (trades, win rate, profit factor, net P&L, max drawdown, Sharpe). tools.name: get_run
tools.description: What it does: fetches one saved run in full. Returns: the spec as submitted, all metrics, the equity curve, the monthly table, name, notes and tags. When to use: to inspect or explain a past run, or to see the exact spec before a rerun or a comparison. Free.

tools.name: compare_runs
tools.description: What it does: puts two saved runs side by side. Returns: the headline metrics of each plus spec_differences, the exact spec fields that differ with both values. When to use: 'is the 40-tick stop better than the 60?', or any A/B question about two runs. Free.

tools.name: rerun
tools.description: What it does: re-runs a saved strategy with changes merged into its spec (objects merge one level down, e.g. {"exit": {"stop_ticks": 50}} changes only the stop; scalars and arrays replace) as a normal backtest and saves a new run. Returns: the same shape as run_backtest. When to use: variations of a

tools.name: name_run
tools.description: What it does: labels a saved run with a name, notes and/or tags (tags replace the run's tags). Returns: {ok: true}. When to use: when the user wants to remember a run or group runs for list_runs' tag filter. Free, nothing is re-run.

tools.name: delete_run
tools.description: What it does: deletes one run from the user's vault. Cannot be undone. Returns: {ok: true}, or 404 if the run is not in this vault. When to use: only when the user explicitly asks to delete a specific run; confirm the run_id with them first.

tools.name: vault_stats
tools.description: What it does: totals over the user's vault. Returns: run count, credits spent, the best run by Sharpe, runs per timeframe. When to use: 'what's my best strategy', or any overview question about everything tested so far. Free.

tools.name: usage
tools.description: What it does: reports this month's credits in one line, e.g. 'starter · 73 of 75 left · resets 2026-11-01' (or, on an account still finishing an earlier free trial, 'Starter trial · 3 of 5 free backtests left').
